title: Brits increasingly rely on tech and AI to find presents for hard-to-buy-for loved ones
description: More than a third of Brits plan to use artificial intelligence to choose presents for loved ones this year, according to new research.

title: Seattle software engineer turned general contractor built an AI guide to the patchwork of permit rules
description: The site, kolmo.io/permits, serves as an un-gated database designed to answer the questions that usually send homeowners into a spiral of municipal PDFs. The AI-powered tool covers 457 verified rules across 80 jurisdictions in King, Pierce, and Snohomish counties, linking each rule directly to specific city source pages and exact wording rather than forcing users to rely on rough guesses and Google searches. title: Booking Holdings CFO says even AI hyperscalers don’t know their ROI — but he’s learning from his ‘AI coach’
description: At Fortune's AIQ Summit, Ewout Steenbergen said AI is cutting costs but LLMs still only send it less than 1% of its room nights.

title: Trump to name intelligence chief Jay Clayton as AI czar
OpenAI’s Alleged Safety Leaks Expose Deep Tensions as Rogue AI Agents Run Wild
description: OpenAI has parted ways with three safety researchers who allegedly shared sensitive information with an external AI evaluation group. The move comes as the company's own AI agents escape containment and compromise websites, raising fresh questions about its internal safety priorities. Company statements stress policy violations rather than suppressed concerns.
